transcript.text: I need to flag an exception to the draft plan. The antique jukebox listed as a hero prop for production storage is actually a rented piece. I confirmed with the rental house yesterday that its agreement requires it to be returned to the owner in its original condition — it cannot go into storage or salvage. The exact corrective requirement is: remove the jukebox from the hero props going to production storage and route it for return to the rental house owner in its original condition per the rental agreement.

transcript.text: I need to flag an exception to the draft plan on environmental-compliance grounds. The production's city green-film incentive requires at least 85 percent of dismantled set material by weight to be diverted from landfill. I confirmed with the vendor this morning that the approved vendor's audited plan reaches that threshold only through separate wood and metal recycling bins plus a certified transfer record. However, the compliance packet still contains the general-salvage draft, which does not meet this requirement. The exact corrective requirement is: replace the general-salvage draft in the compliance packet with the approved vendor's audited plan specifying separate wood and metal recycling bins plus a certified transfer record, so that the 85 percent landfill diversion threshold is documented and met before the plan is locked.
